node.statement: Invoke node 1.2 at the terminal index r=q (this step depends on node 1.2, rather than treating its sibling conclusion as inherited context). Node 1.2 supplies a current reset isomorphism v_{U_q}:M_q->A_{U_q}, recorded field epsilon_{U_q}=W.L*epsilon, the bound d_{U_q}<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_q}, and the unit bound ||v_{U_q}(I_{M_q})-u_{A_{U_q}}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_q}. Since U_q={j_1,...,j_q}=C and q=|C| by the enumeration, substitution gives M_q=M_{|C|}, A_{U_q}=A_C, v_C:=v_{U_q}, and epsilon_C:=epsilon_{U_q}=W.L*epsilon. Node 1.1 gives that A_C is an extended epsilon_C-C*-algebra, and node 1.1 (equivalently the structural-ledger inequality recorded there) gives epsilon_C=W.L*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon. Thus this datum has exactly the source, target, isomorphism tag, recorded ambient field, defect bound, and unit bound asserted at node 1.3.
